question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only C sits between A and E. E sits third to the left of D. B sits to the immediate left of D. G is not an immediate neighbour of E. How many people sit between C and G when counted from the right of C?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

E sits third to the left of D.

B sits to the immediate left of D.

Only C sits between A and E.

G is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15840cc31c535df98cc4d94cb6cc388ac9c9069195a2647be5155404c6d5e7f6.png] 

Thus, 4 people sit between C and G when counted from the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
